title: Quote of the Day by Epicurus: ‘Men inflict injuries from hatred, jealousy or contempt but the wise man masters...’ - the ancient philosopher’s lesson on emotional control, reason and conflict, and why mastering destructive passions still matters in everyday life
description: Quote of the Day by Epicurus: Epicurus taught that reason masters destructive passions like hatred and jealousy. He believed wisdom involved governing responses rather than being driven by emotions. This ancient philosophy emphasizes self-control as a form of wisdom for daily life. Epicurus' ideas focused on achieving tranquility by managing desires and fears. His teachings remain relevant for navigating everyday conflicts and finding inner peace.
